intent: Remove integer-frame transform keyframes from materialized production V3 plans; resolved samples support every visual 2.5D layer type and do not require a camera rig.

implementation.behavior: For unshuttered V3 plans, fill every presentation-frame timestamp; shutter plans use the canonical C3D shutter calendar. Camera and supported layer transforms use the same sampleFrames when a rig is authored. Layer transform sampling also works for camera-free plans. Light and Mesh are excluded; non-transform animation fails closed.
implementation.null_controller: Motion Null/controller layers are omitted from renderable RenderPlan layers; their resolved world transforms are folded into content/camera samples.
